[BugSigDB](https://bugsigdb.org) Stats and Analysis

## Citation

Ludwig Geistlinger, Chloe Mirzayi, Fatima Zohra, Rimsha Azhar, Shaimaa
Elsafoury, Clare Grieve, Jennifer Wokaty, Samuel David Gamboa-Tuz,
Pratyay Sengupta, Isaac Hecht, Aarthi Ravikrishnan, Rafael Goncalves,
Eric Franzosa, Karthik Raman, Vincent Carey, Jennifer B. Dowd, Heidi E.
Jones, Sean Davis, Nicola Segata, Curtis Huttenhower, Levi Waldron
(2023) BugSigDB captures patterns of differential abundance across a
broad range of host-associated microbial signatures. *Nature
Biotechnology*, doi:
[10.1038/s41587-023-01872-y](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-023-01872-y).

## bugsigdb-related links

- [bugsigdb.org](https://bugsigdb.org): A Comprehensive Database of
  Published Microbial Signatures
- [BugSigDB issue
  tracker](https://github.com/waldronlab/BugSigDB/issues): Report bugs
  or feature requests for bugsigdb.org
- [BugSigDBExports](https://github.com/waldronlab/BugSigDBExports):
  Hourly data exports of bugsigdb.org
- [Stable data releases](https://zenodo.org/records/6468009): Periodic
  manually-reviewed stable data releses on Zenodo
- [bugsigdbr](https://bioconductor.org/packages/bugsigdbr/):
  R/Bioconductor access to published microbial signatures from BugSigDB
- [Curation
  issues](https://github.com/waldronlab/BugSigDBcuration/issues): Report
  curation issues, requests studies to be added
- [bugSigSimple](https://github.com/waldronlab/bugSigSimple): Simple
  analyses of BugSigDB data in R
- [BugSigDBStats](https://github.com/waldronlab/BugSigDBStats):
  Statistics and trends of BugSigDB
- [BugSigDBPaper](https://github.com/waldronlab/BugSigDBPaper):
  Reproduces analyses of the [Nature Biotechnology
  publication](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-023-01872-y)
- [community-bioc Slack Team](https://slack.bioconductor.org/): Join
  \#bugsigdb channel

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calcJaccardSimilarity()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/calcJaccardSimilarity.md)
  : Calculate pairwise Jaccard similarity between all signatures
- [`calcPairwiseOverlaps()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/calcPairwiseOverlaps.md)
  : Calculate pairwise overlaps between all signatures
- [`calcSemanticSimilarity()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/calcSemanticSimilarity.md)
  : Calculate semantic similarity
- [`getMostFrequentTaxa()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/getMostFrequentTaxa.md)
  : Get most frequent taxa
- [`getNcbiTaxonomyObo()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/getNcbiTaxonomyObo.md)
  : Get NCBI Taxonomy in OBO format
- [`getTaxLevelDistribution()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/getTaxLevelDistribution.md)
  : Get distribution of taxonomic levels
- [`getTaxonStats()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/getTaxonStats.md)
  : Taxon stats
- [`makeDist()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/makeDist.md)
  : Title Create a Jaccard or overlap dissimilarity matrix from the
  output of calcPairwiseOverlaps
- [`microbeHeatmap()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/microbeHeatmap.md)
  : Plot microbe co-occurrence in a heatmap
- [`paperStat()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/paperStat.md)
  : Paper stats
- [`plotComposition()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/plotComposition.md)
  : Plot composition of a table of a categorical variable
- [`plotCuratorStats()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/plotCuratorStats.md)
  : Plot curation output for each curator
- [`plotProgressOverTime()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/plotProgressOverTime.md)
  : Plot curation output as a function of time
- [`plotUniqueMicrobesOverTime()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/plotUniqueMicrobesOverTime.md)
  : Plot curation output for each curator
- [`pmid2pubyear()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/pmid2pubyear.md)
  : Get the publication year for a PMID
- [`sigStat()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/sigStat.md)
  : Signature stats
- [`stratifyByCurator()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/stratifyByCurator.md)
  : Stratify curation output by curator
- [`stripEmptySignatures()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/stripEmptySignatures.md)
  : Remove entries that do not contain signatures
- [`syncWithNCBI()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/syncWithNCBI.md)
  : Synchronize signatures with NCBI Taxonomy
- [`tabCol()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/tabCol.md) :
  Table column
- [`tabDiv()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/tabDiv.md) :
  Table diversity column
- [`testAssociation()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/testAssociation.md)
  : Test association of a taxon with a certain category of a column
- [`testReplicability()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/testReplicability.md)
  : Test replicability of microbiome changes across studies
- [`weightedBMA()`](http://waldronlab.io/BugSigDBStats/reference/weightedBMA.md)
  : Weighted semantic similarity
